pr.title: fix(editor): Hide private credential connect controls without update permission
pr.body:
## Summary

Users with only `credential:read` on a private (resolvable) credential — e.g. a `project:viewer` — were still shown the **Connect** button on the credential card and the **Connect** link in the node detail view. Clicking it failed server-side, since the OAuth endpoints require `credential:update`. This gates both affordances behind the `credential:update` scope so they only appear to users who can actually act on them; the informational "not connected yet" callout still renders. The Disconnect action is intentionally left ungated, since the backend always allows a user to clear their own stored connection.

**To test:** As a `project:viewer`, open the credential list and a node that uses an unconnected private credential — the Connect button/link should no longer appear (only the status notice). As an owner/editor, the Connect controls should still appear and work.

## Related Linear tickets, Github issues, and Community forum posts

https://linear.app/n8n/issue/IAM-746

<details>
<summary>Architecture diagram</summary>

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant UI as CredentialCard/NodeCredentials UI
    participant Permissions as PermissionsStore
    participant CredStore as CredentialsStore
    participant Router as Vue Router

    Note over UI,Router: CredentialCard flow

    UI->>CredStore: Get credential data (including scopes)
    CredStore-->>UI: { isResolvable, connectedByMe, scopes }
    UI->>Permissions: getResourcePermissions(scopes)
    Permissions-->>UI: { credential: { update: boolean } }

    alt isResolvable AND NOT connectedByMe AND credential.update === true
        UI->>UI: Render Connect button (credential-card-connect)
        UI->>UI: Render "not connected" callout
    else isResolvable AND NOT connectedByMe AND credential.update === false
        UI->>UI: Render only "not connected" callout
        Note over UI: Connect button hidden
    end

    Note over UI,Router: NodeCredentials flow

    UI->>CredStore: Get selected private credential for type
    CredStore-->>UI: credential object with scopes
    UI->>UI: Call canConnectPrivateCredential()
    UI->>Permissions: getResourcePermissions(credential.scopes)
    Permissions-->>UI: { credential: { update: boolean } }

    alt credential.update === true
        UI->>UI: Render Connect link (node-credential-private-connect)
        UI->>Router: Click → editCredential()
    else credential.update === false
        UI->>UI: Render only "not connected" text
        Note over UI: Connect link hidden
    end

    alt credential.update === true AND credential.connectedByMe === true
        UI->>UI: Render Disconnect action
        Note over UI: Disconnect always shown regardless of update permission
    end
```
</details>

commits.message:
fix(editor): Hide private credential connect controls without update permission

Gate the private-credential Connect button on the credential card and the
Connect link in the node detail view behind the credential:update scope, so
users who can only read a credential (e.g. project:viewer) are no longer shown
a control that fails server-side.
